# Trainry

_A training timer app: build workout plans out of timed segments and run them on a big timer screen. ⏱️_

</div>

&nbsp;

## How to run it

Live at [trainry.webry.com](https://trainry.webry.com/).

1. `pnpm install`
2. `pnpm dev`
